pool_images.why: CS-4715-POOL, 27 Sept 2026: pool-size estimate for the BnF fr.4715 Vieuville-Nevers pool (POOL.md) -- 3 recto canvases at 600px for folios not yet on disk, sampled from the open/partial (non-found-solved) rows, eye-compared against f81r's known 2,524 signs for a rough sign density estimate. Not transcribed.

pool_f50r_600.jpg.note: dense continuous cipher for about 22 lines (top ~60% of the leaf), later-hand marginal notes below, then blank; estimated ~1,500 signs

pool_f60r_600.jpg.note: dense continuous cipher for about 22-24 lines, similar layout to f50r; estimated ~1,500-1,600 signs

pool_f67r_600.jpg.note: mostly clear French prose with only a handful of scattered numeral code-groups per line, not a dense cipher leaf despite the BnF catalogue's 'avec chiffre' note; estimated ~50-150 signs
